description: Jest runs automated JavaScript tests. We will write small tests, read their results and learn how to keep tests clear and repeatable. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
learningObjectives: Practise choose a mock return value
Practise run a table of cases

seo.title: Jest Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Jest with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
